correctness.rationale: Normalized spherical-harmonic addition theorem reduces the all-degree Gram matrices to a 63x63 signed or unsigned E7 root-angle matrix. Exhaustive exact root enumeration checks B^2=14B+32I, A^2=16I+16J, the tight-frame identity, and all pairwise counts. The resulting 2 odd and 3 even eigenvalue branches are proved algebraically. Rational Gegenbauer recurrence covers degrees 0..10, and the normalized Laplace beta-integral yields explicit inequalities U4<1/16 and 32 U6+30 V6<1 proving universal high-degree positivity; the parity direct-sum calculation proves the exact consecutive-degree cutoff. The self-contained public checker passed; finite tests are not asserted to prove the analytic tail.

value.rationale: A canonical 126-point exceptional spherical configuration has a nontrivial all-degree harmonic interpolation problem. The theorem identifies every spectral level, rules out any unknown later rank drops, and gives a sharp adjacent-degree interpolation cutoff, with a one-dimensional obstruction immediately below the cutoff. It is an exact natural structural invariant useful for spectral approximation, not a single arbitrary parameter evaluation.
